description: This file defines an interface for a catalog lookup data service in a Blazor web application, including a generic method to list lookup data items.

classes.name: ICatalogLookupDataService
classes.description: A generic interface for catalog lookup data services, providing an asynchronous method to retrieve a list of lookup data items.

methods.name: List
methods.description: An asynchronous method that returns a list of lookup data items of type TLookupData.
